
```{r}
#| label: cell-table
table(colData(sce)$cell_id)
```

## Exploratory Analysis

```{r}
#| label: plot-distributions
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 6

p <- ggplot(as.data.frame(colData(sce)), aes(x = nuclear_fraction))

p + geom_density(fill = "lightblue", alpha = 0.5) +
  facet_wrap(~ cell_id) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = paste("Distribution of Nuclear Fraction by cell identity"),
       x = "Nuclear Fraction")

p + aes(y = log10(sum), colour = "cell_id") +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6, size = 0.6) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = paste("UMI Counts vs Nuclear Fraction by cell identity"),
       x = "Nuclear Fraction",
       y = "log10(UMI Sum)")
```

## Normalization and Dimensionality Reduction

```{r}
#| label: dimensionality-reduction-pca
#| eval: !expr '!"PCA" %in% SingleCellExperiment::reducedDimNames(sce)'

sce <- logNormCounts(sce)
dec <- modelGeneVar(sce)
hvgs <- getTopHVGs(dec, prop = 0.1)

sce <- runPCA(sce, subset_row = hvgs, ncomponents = 50)
sce <- runUMAP(sce, dimred = "PCA")
```

```{r}
#| label: dimensionality-reduction-scgpt
#| eval: !expr '!"UMAP_scGPT" %in% SingleCellExperiment::reducedDimNames(sce)'

sce <- runUMAP(sce, dimred = "scGPT", name = "UMAP_scGPT")
```


```{r}
#| label: dimensionality-reduction-gf
#| eval: !expr '!"UMAP_GeneFormer" %in% SingleCellExperiment::reducedDimNames(sce)'

sce <- runUMAP(sce, dimred = "GeneFormer", name = "UMAP_GeneFormer")
```


```{r}
#| label: plot-dimred
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 10

umapsm <- plotUMAP(sce, colour_by = "cell_id", dimred = "UMAP") +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom") +
  labs(title = "UMAP (PCA) colored by cell identity")
pcasm  <- plotPCA(sce, colour_by = "cell_id") +
  theme(legend.position = "none") +
  labs(title = "PCA colored by cell identity")

umapnf <- plotUMAP(sce, colour_by = "nuclear_fraction", dimred = "UMAP") +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom") +
  labs(title = "UMAP (PCA) colored by nuclear fraction")
pcanf  <- plotPCA(sce, colour_by = "nuclear_fraction") +
  theme(legend.position = "none") +
  labs(title = "PCA colored by nuclear fraction")

umapgs <- plotUMAP(sce, colour_by = "cell_id", dimred = "UMAP_scGPT") +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom") +
  labs(title = "UMAP (scGPT) colored by cell identity")
umapgnf <- plotUMAP(sce, colour_by = "nuclear_fraction", dimred = "UMAP_scGPT") +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom") +
  labs(title = "UMAP (scGPT) colored by nuclear fraction")

(pcasm | pcanf) / (umapsm | umapnf)
```

```{r}
#| label: plot-umap-scgpt
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 5

(umapgs | umapgnf)
```

```{r}
#| label: plot-umap-gf
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 5
#| eval: !expr has_geneformer

if (has_geneformer) {
  umapgfs <- plotUMAP(sce, colour_by = "cell_id", dimred = "UMAP_GeneFormer") +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom") +
    labs(title = "UMAP (GeneFormer) colored by cell identity")
  umapgfnf <- plotUMAP(sce, colour_by = "nuclear_fraction", dimred = "UMAP_GeneFormer") +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom") +
    labs(title = "UMAP (GeneFormer) colored by nuclear fraction")
  print(umapgfs | umapgfnf)
}
```

## Focus on MALAT1 and Nuclear Fraction Relationship

```{r}
#| label: malat1-plots
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 5
#| eval: !expr has_malat1

if (has_malat1) {
  umapm <- plotUMAP(sce, colour_by = "MALAT1") + theme(legend.position = "bottom") +
    labs(title = "UMAP (PCA) colored by MALAT1 log expression")
  umapgptm <- plotUMAP(sce, colour_by = "MALAT1", dimred = "UMAP_scGPT") + theme(legend.position = "bottom") +
    labs(title = "UMAP (scGPT) colored by MALAT1")

  if (has_geneformer) {
    umapgfm <- plotUMAP(sce, colour_by = "MALAT1", dimred = "UMAP_GeneFormer") + theme(legend.position = "bottom") +
      labs(title = "UMAP (GeneFormer) colored by MALAT1")

    print(umapm | umapgfm | umapgptm)
    print(umapgnf | umapgptm | umapgs)
    print(umapgfnf | umapgfm | umapgfs)
  } else {
    print(pcanf | plotPCA(sce, colour_by = "MALAT1"))
    print(umapnf | umapm)
    print(umapm | umapgptm)
    print(umapgnf | umapgptm | umapgs)
  }
  print(umapm | umapnf | umapsm)
}
```

```{r}
#| label: scatter-malat1-nf
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 6
#| eval: !expr has_malat1

if (has_malat1) {
  print(plotExpression(sce,
                 features = "MALAT1",
                 x = "nuclear_fraction",
                 other_fields = "cell_id",
                 exprs_values = "logcounts") +
    facet_wrap(~ cell_id) +
    aes(color = "cell_id") +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(title = "MALAT1 Expression vs Nuclear Fraction per cell identity",
         x = "Nuclear Fraction",
         y = "MALAT1 Expression (logcounts)"))
}
```

## Empty Droplet and Damaged Cell Identification

```{r}
#| label: empty-droplets
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 6

nf_umi <- data.frame(
  nf = sce$nuclear_fraction,
  umi = sce$sum,
  cell_id = colData(sce)$cell_id
)

rownames(nf_umi) <- colnames(sce)
nf_umi <- nf_umi[!is.na(nf_umi$nf),]

cb_ed <- identify_empty_drops(nf_umi = nf_umi, include_plot = TRUE)
table(cb_ed$cell_status)
```

```{r}
#| label: cell_status-add
#| eval: false

sce$cell_status <- cb_ed[colnames(sce), "cell_status"]
```

```{r}
#| label: table-cell-status
table(colData(sce)$cell_id, sce$cell_status)
```

```{r}
#| label: cell-status-boxplots
#| fig-width: 14
#| fig-height: 6

p1 <- sce[, !is.na(sce$cell_status)] |>
  ggcells(aes(x = cell_status, y = nuclear_fraction, fill = cell_status)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7, outlier.size = 0.5) +
  facet_wrap(~ cell_id) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Nuclear fraction distribution for cell status",
    x = "Cell Status",
    y = "Nuclear Fraction",
    fill = "Status"
  )

if (has_malat1) {
  p2 <- sce[, !is.na(sce$cell_status)] |>
    ggcells(aes(x = cell_status, y = MALAT1, fill = cell_status)) +
    geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7, outlier.size = 0.5) +
    facet_wrap(~ cell_id) +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(
      title = "MALAT1 distribution for cell status",
      x = "Cell Status",
      y = "MALAT1 logexpression",
      fill = "Status"
    )
  print(p1 | p2)
} else {
  print(p1)
}
```

```{r}
#| label: damaged-cells
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 12

cb_ed_dc <- identify_damaged_cells(cb_ed, verbose = FALSE, output_plots = TRUE)

table(cb_ed_dc[[1]]$cell_status)

if (length(cb_ed_dc[[2]]) > 0) {
  # Stampa o unisci i grafici solo se la lista NON è vuota
  patchwork::wrap_plots(cb_ed_dc[[2]], ncol = 2)
} else {
  message("Nessuna cellula danneggiata identificata o nessun grafico da mostrare.")
}
```

```{r}
#| label: cell_status-add2
#| eval: false

sce$cell_status <- cb_ed_dc[[1]][colnames(sce), "cell_status"]
```

```{r}
#| label: table-cell-status-2
table(colData(sce)$cell_id, sce$cell_status)
```

```{r}
#| label: umap-damaged-empty
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 10

umapc <- plotUMAP(sce, colour_by = "cell_status") + theme(legend.position = "bottom") +
  labs(title = "UMAP (PCA) colored by cell status")
pcam  <- plotPCA(sce, colour_by = "cell_status") + theme(legend.position = "bottom") +
  labs(title = "PCA colored by cell status")
umapec <- plotUMAP(sce, colour_by = "cell_status", dimred = "UMAP_scGPT") + theme(legend.position = "bottom") +
  labs(title = "UMAP (scGPT) colored by cell status")

if (has_geneformer) {
  umapeg <- plotUMAP(sce, colour_by = "cell_status", dimred = "UMAP_GeneFormer") + theme(legend.position = "bottom") +
    labs(title = "UMAP (GeneFormer) colored by cell status")
  print((umapc | pcam) / (umapec | umapeg))
} else {
  print(umapc | pcam | umapec)
}
```

```{r}
#| label: umaps-cs-malat1
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 5
#| eval: !expr has_malat1

if (has_malat1) {
  if (has_geneformer) {
    print(umapec | umapgptm | umapgs)
    print(umapeg | umapgfm | umapgfs)
  } else {
    print(umapec | umapgptm | umapgs)
  }
}
```

```{r}
#| label: umaps-cs
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 5
#| eval: !expr "!has_malat1"

if (!has_malat1) {
  print(umapec | umapgs)
}
```
